d: Against the backdrop of a gay-pride parade, shocking secrets are revealed. Bette and Kit deal with their rapidly deteriorating father.
Bette moves her father into her home for his final days. Dana's dinner with an ex sparks jealousy in Alice. Jenny engages in risky behavior.
Melvin's funeral is attended by a surprise guest. Bette is blindsided by professional news and Tina faces a difficult labor. Jenny finally seeks help.
Bette and Tina are back together and parenting Tina's newborn daughter, Angelica. Jenny, fed up with Midwest life, ponders moving back to Los Angeles.
Jenny and Moira embark on an eventful road trip. Alice struggles with dependency on anti-depressants and Dana copes with finding a lump in her breast.
Shane opens her own hair-styling business. Bette loses her job, forcing Tina to take work with Helena. Jenny and Moira arrive back in Los Angeles.
Bette travels to Washington D.C. to speak at a Senate hearing. Jenny puts her dreams of becoming a writer on hold and starts working as a waitress.
Tina finds herself attracted to men online. Dana receives a cancer diagnosis and needs surgery. Moira goes out on the town as her male alter-ego Max.
Tina to explores her feelings for men. Billie offers Moira testosterone drugs. Dana checks herself into the hospital to begin breast cancer treatment.
In Vancouver, Tina explores her feelings for the opposite sex. In Los Angeles, Dana's cancer treatments take a toll. Moira begins hormone injections.
Jenny plans an event to help Moira pay for surgery. The girls go on a trip to honor Dana's expected recovery. Bette kicks Tina out of the bedroom.

st: Lead, Follow Or Get Out Of The Way
d: Tina goes on a date with a divorced man. Jenny throws a party for Max, but is appalled by their behavior. Helena's affair with Dylan takes a turn.
Lara is still in Paris, oblivious to Dana's worsening health. Jenny introduces Max to her former boyfriend. Peggy helps Helena with Dylan's lawsuit.
Dana's uptight and fiercely conservative parents attend her funeral, still in denial to her true sexual orientation. Lara finally arrives home.
Helena starts planning Shane and Carmen's wedding. Kit announces her pregnancy. Alice drowns her grief with anti-depressants and mindless sex.
The fourth season opens with a tense custody battle between Bette and Tina. Shane falls into a spiral and Kit faces pregnancy problems.
